metas.name: Us
metas.description: A family on a beach vacation is attacked by their own doppelgängers, and the horror grows into a twisted allegory about who gets to live which life. The final reveal changes everything that came before.

metas.name: Mulholland Drive
metas.description: An aspiring actress and an amnesiac woman try to work out the amnesiac's identity in Los Angeles, until their roles invert and the dream sours. It's David Lynch's ultimate puzzle film about performance and stolen identity.

metas.name: Lost Highway
metas.description: A jazz saxophonist accused of murdering his wife inexplicably turns into another man entirely. Lynch's noir about split identities runs on dread, and its loop structure begs to be decoded.

metas.name: Triangle
metas.description: Yachting friends board a deserted ocean liner, and one woman begins running into versions of herself. It's a tightly plotted loop thriller where each double reveals something worse.

metas.name: Possession
metas.description: A Berlin marriage disintegrates, and the husband finds a calm, angelic double of his wife while she spirals into something monstrous. Andrzej Żuławski's ferocious film is unlike anything else.

metas.name: Shattered Glass
metas.description: A charming young journalist at The New Republic turns out to have invented dozens of his stories. The film is a gripping true account of a compulsive impostor whose performance collapses one fact-check at a time.

metas.name: Black Swan
metas.description: A ballerina cast as both the White and the Black Swan is consumed by the role and by a rival who seems to be her dark double. Darren Aronofsky's psychological horror is about performance swallowing a person.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: Near the end of a three-year solo contract on a lunar mining base, a worker meets a man who is exactly him. It's a quiet, tense sci-fi mystery about identity and corporate cruelty.

metas.name: Changeling
metas.description: In 1928 Los Angeles, police return a mother's missing son, and she insists the boy is not him. Clint Eastwood's true-story thriller is an impostor case wrapped in institutional cruelty.

metas.name: The Spanish Prisoner
metas.description: An inventor with a valuable secret is lured into an elaborate con in which everyone around him may be playing a part. David Mamet's precise puzzle-box thriller keeps pulling the rug away.
